summary: Melco Resorts & Entertainment Limited filed a Form 6-K furnishing the quarterly report of its subsidiary Melco Resorts Finance Limited for the three and six months ended June 30, 2026. The exhibit contains unaudited condensed consolidated financial statements (balance sheet, income statement, cash flows) and related MD&A. The filing references outstanding senior notes (2027, 2028, 2029, 2032, 2033) and the Macau concession, but no transaction, tender, restructuring, or strategic action is announced. It is purely a routine periodic financial reporting disclosure by a foreign private issuer.
